_doc: DURABLE RECONCILIATION EVIDENCE (Peter, Nov 13 2026). Facts established once, from sources that
EXPIRE, recorded here so a later run can still reach the same verdict. GitHub Actions logs are
retained for a limited window: the proof below lives in run logs that will be deleted, so without
this file every one of these rows silently reverts to UNRESOLVED when the logs age out.
THIS FILE NEVER RELEASES ANYTHING. novig_venue_recon.py reads it to LABEL a row and writes
nothing. Clearing a submission claim or an intent latch remains Peter's manual, subject-only
INTENT CLEARED email. A verdict here is a statement about evidence, not an instruction to act.
PRECEDENCE: a live venue match always wins. Evidence is applied only to a row the live sources
cannot already resolve, so a row that is CONFIRMED AT VENUE can never be overwritten by an entry
here - which is what keeps the Louisiana key safe, since its third attempt DID reach the venue.
Each entry states what KIND of evidence it is. They are not interchangeable:
proven_pre_execution - positive proof the order code never ran. The strongest kind: it does not
depend on reading the venue at all.
terminal_at_venue    - the venue itself reported a terminal status for a known order id.
no_dispatch_evidence - NOT proof. Absence of a dispatch record. Recorded for continuity only;
rows carrying it stay UNRESOLVED and stay blocked.

entries.verdict: RULED OUT - proven pre-execution failure, the order code never ran
entries.play: r1|NCAAF|Louisiana Ragin Cajuns @ UL Monroe Warhawks|total|UNDER (and its bare-key twin)
entries.evidence: Two dispatches of novig-live-order carried this play and BOTH died before Python started: each log ends with "'python' is not recognized as an internal or external command" and exit code 1, with no output from novig_live_order.py at all. The interpreter was absent from PATH on the self-hosted runner, so not one line of the script executed and no POST /v3/orders was ever issued. This is positive proof of non-execution and does not rely on any venue read. A third dispatch 4 minutes later succeeded once PATH was fixed - that one is 9876e410d17d45fd, already CONFIRMED AT VENUE (filled 43300), and is excluded here by the live-match precedence rule.

entries.verdict: UNRESOLVED - intent journalled, no dispatch evidence
entries.evidence: An intent was journalled but the row never reached 'placed'. Census of every novig-live-order workflow_dispatch since Oct 28: 36 dispatches, of which 34 produced a runner record and 2 are the interpreter-missing failures above - so every dispatch is accounted for and none carried this play. Zero runner records mention it. The cloud reaches Novig only by dispatching to the home runner, so place() was never invoked. NOTE: this is an absence-of-evidence argument, not positive proof, which is why the verdict stays UNRESOLVED and the claim stays blocked.
